purpose: Candidate rationale, not evidence for regulation of the study ncORFs

trigger.scope: Mouse Malat1 B1-SINE IRES, Rack1 and hnRNP A2/B1; neither present in current study eCLIP manifest

candidates.title: Protein Factor Requirements of the Apaf-1 Internal Ribosome Entry Segment: Roles of Polypyrimidine Tract Binding Protein and upstream of N-ras
candidates.evidence: Recombinant PTB/unr supplementation and cell experiments support APAF1 IRES function. PTB binding depends on unr in this system.
candidates.limit: Target-specific cellular IRES, not general ncORF or microprotein mechanism; do not equate PTBP1 with neuronal PTBP2.

candidates.title: Heterogeneous Nuclear Ribonucleoprotein C Modulates Translation of c-myc mRNA in a Cell Cycle Phase-Dependent Manner
candidates.evidence: Binding to a U-rich c-MYC IRES region, recombinant protein and binding-site mutant experiments; cell-cycle-dependent activity.
candidates.limit: Canonical MYC and specific cell-cycle context, not study ncORFs.

candidates.title: DDX3 depletion represses translation of mRNAs with complex 5′ UTRs
candidates.evidence: Ribosome profiling, RNA-seq, PAR-CLIP and reporter work support transcript-selective translation dependence and structured5′UTR involvement.
candidates.limit: Not IRES-specific and not microprotein-specific; measured occupancy here is observational and not a DDX3 depletion experiment.

candidates.title: Heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein A1 is a novel internal ribosome entry site trans-acting factor that modulates alternative initiation of translation of the fibroblast growth factor2 mRNA
candidates.evidence: FGF2 IRES binding, recombinant complementation and siRNA experiments support target-specific initiation involvement.
candidates.limit: Distinct from HNRNPA2B1. Direction may vary by target; no generic promotion hypothesis.
